newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Orbotech up on earnings.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Orbotech up on earnings.

text.p: Orbotech Ltd rose in morning trade Monday after the Israeli company released surprisingly strong earnings for the second quarter.
"They (earnings) were much, much better than anyone expected," said one trader. "People are revising their estimates for the year and the following one."
The company's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) were up 3-57/64 at 39-3/8. Orbotech reported a profit of $0.62 per share for the quarter, up from $0.38 a year ago.
The company provides automated optical inspection equipment for the manufacture of printed circuit boards.
Trading in Latin American and European ADRs was relatively quiet, according to other traders.
Brazilian telephone holding company Telebras SA was down 1-11/16 at 138-1/2 amid apprehension about Brazil's current account figure, due later today.
"There's a negative feel," said one dealer.
Nordic mobile phone maker Nokia Group was down 2-3/4 at 84 despite a report quoting its chief executive officer as saying he is maintaining a "strongly positive outlook" for the next six months.
"It (the company's ADR) is already fully priced," said one trader, explaining how it had risen quite a bit in previous sessions.
Among other ADRs, Telefonos de Mexico was down 3/16 at 54-7/8, and British Airways was 5-1/16 lower at 100-1/2.
Decliners led advancers 254 to 214 among 814 ADRs.
The ADR group was down 0.12 percent on a volume of 34.0 million ADRs.
ADRs enable U.S. trading of foreign stock.
